about:
Century Wire Products Corp. was established in 1998 in Wind Gap, Pennsylvania, drawing on more than 45 years of wire-industry experience. The company is 100% woman-owned; founder Danielle relocated the operation from Washington to Wind Gap in 2009, bringing many employees with her.

The Pennsylvania plant manufactures stainless steel lashing wire, single-end wire, messenger strand, and galvanized EHS Class A strand to ASTM A475 standards, plus galvanized fencing and domestic strand. All lashing wire is made in the USA and can be certified on request. The facility holds ISO 9001:2015 certification, is EDI-capable, and stocks major sizes for 24-hour shipment; custom orders are produced to customer specifications.

Primary markets include CATV, telecommunications, and industrial sectors, with products used in broadband and federal infrastructure projects subject to Build America, Buy America requirements. Customers range from contractors to grant recipients; the company supports industry groups such as the Cable Television Engineers Society, the Walter Katz Scholarship Foundation, and the Missouri Cable Technical Association.

Danielle's leadership emphasizes employment of people with disabilities through a long-standing partnership with Abilities of Northwest New Jersey, earning her the Private Enterprise Award from ACCESS NJ. The firm's WBENC certification, domestic manufacturing, and rapid stock fulfillment are cited as key differentiators.
